title.zh: 德意志银行将在数周内推出首项数字资产服务
title.en: 德意志银行将在数周内推出首项数字资产服务

current_state.zh: Deutsche Bank's corporate banking co-head says the bank will roll out its first digital asset service within weeks, starting with crypto custody in Germany for major coins before expanding to Asian financial hubs, and later adding stablecoin services, tokenized deposits and digital bond issuance.
current_state.en: Deutsche Bank's corporate banking co-head says the bank will roll out its first digital asset service within weeks, starting with crypto custody in Germany for major coins before expanding to Asian financial hubs, and later adding stablecoin services, tokenized deposits and digital bond issuance.
